lines.text: バナナは木じゃないって知ってた？
prompts: a bunch of green bananas hanging from a banana plant in a sunny tropical garden, storybook style
a ripe yellow banana bunch on a wooden table in warm light

lines.text: 実は、世界でも最大級の草の仲間なんだ。
prompts: a very tall banana plant with huge green leaves towering over a small farmhouse, storybook style

lines.text: 木の幹に見える部分は、葉の根もとが重なったもの。
prompts: thick layered green leaf bases wrapped around each other forming a tall pale green stalk, soft painting
a farmer gently touching the soft green stalk of a banana plant

lines.text: これは偽茎と呼ばれ、本物の木のような硬い幹ではない。
prompts: a soft green banana stalk standing beside a hard brown oak tree trunk in a meadow

lines.text: バナナは、ひとつの茎に一度だけ実をつけると言われている。
prompts: a large purple banana flower hanging down from the top of a plant
small green bananas growing in neat rows from a flower stalk

lines.text: 実を収穫したあとの茎は、切られて新しい芽に場所をゆずるんだ。
prompts: a young green banana shoot growing beside a freshly cut stalk in a sunny field
several banana plants of different heights growing together in a plantation

lines.text: フォローして、次の雑学も受け取ってね！
prompts: a cozy still life of a banana bunch with soft pastel background and warm light
